A splits inline parsing into small single-purpose functions (parseAt, parseLink, parseEmphasis) with a trivial driver loop, so each rule can be read and changed in isolation, whereas B packs all rules, the literal-buffer flushing, and nested fallthrough conditions into one long renderInline that is harder to reason about safely.
